title.narrative: Strengthened Parliamentary oversight in protecting rights of citizens and fostering responsive and accountable governance.

title.narrative: Improved good governance and economic development through timely passing of good laws.

description.narrative: Cumulatively since 2020, 13 Bills were passed timely and all taking into consideration the views of the public derived from public hearings and thereby strengthening public engagement in the law making process. Laws passed are contributing to governance and socioeconomic development . All bills subjected to public scrutiny with about 30 percent of public inputs taken on board in the final laws passed. For instance ,Some of the laws are the Constitution Amendments 1 and 2 affecting the governance of the country through changes in constitutional provisions regulating appointment of judges and provision of quota system in local government to increase womens participation in politics. The Education, Innovation, Research & Development Act, No 5 of 2021 contributed contributing to economic development through harnessing of talent and innovation through private and public sector partnerships
% of recommendations for Bill Amendments from Committees incorporated into law by the executive.
